independent_review.summary: Read-only review completed for all five new files against deko3d base 373bfd43d8b2d805fa2eb7d406dbb823032df958 and Mesa pin 0ff52079ca9e9e837ed27eb95a8d239f439a1864. No material source-level defect found within the declared narrow contract. Format traits, TIC swizzling, numeric Z-target values, Mesa format tables and packed-format tests consistently place stencil in byte0/X; W would target depth. The B0B5 contracts support NoWrite=6, remap 0x03006660 and launch 0x686 with FORCE_RMW_DISABLE clear. Destination width/origin use remapped element units, not multiplied-by-four byte units. Packet register spans, address high/low ordering, setup-before-launch ordering and reservation match existing command helpers. Bounds subtraction, uint64_t pitch/span arithmetic, allocation checks and guarded range additions avoid overflow; final source-row padding is correctly unnecessary. Validation precedes command emission. Remap state is explicitly programmed, and ordinary copies disable or replace it. Ownership, virtual-address aliasing, cache maintenance and inter-engine synchronization remain explicit caller obligations. Existing public header/copy implementation are unchanged. Reviewed existing logs confirm 19 normal and 19 sanitized host cases passed; no builds or tests were run during this review, and no files were modified.
independent_review.acceptance: PASS only as an isolated, controlled source/command-encoding prototype. NVK's rejection of this exact packed format does not invalidate the source-derived X mapping, but prevents claiming an existing NVK execution precedent. GM20B NoWrite/RMW behavior, block-linear execution and actual depth preservation remain unverified. This verdict does not establish full-library build success, production readiness or a finalized/published API, and does not authorize hardware use.

review_suggestions_resolved: Add overlap/adjacency, pitch overflow, destination range and view mip-count tests
review_suggestion_before_broader_accepta: Exercise real adapter command positions and ordinary-copy alternation; requires separately scoped execution
